name: PantoSource for WooCommerce
author: PantoSource

sections.description:
PantoSource fixes your tracking data, including the conversions browser pixels miss, and enriches it with your real profit and hashed customer details. You see real profit and POAS (profit on ad spend) for every campaign, channel, and store. Your ad platforms learn from complete and enriched data, and you can make better decisions.

Connect Claude, ChatGPT, or any other AI chat through the PantoSource MCP and turn it into an analyst that knows your store. Ask about campaign optimization, budget allocation across campaigns and channels, profit, POAS, conversions, customers, and creatives, and get clear recommendations on what to fix, cut, and scale, built on your complete data. You decide what to act on.

Browsers and ad blockers stop 40 to 60% of pixel events before they reach ad platforms. Platforms then optimize on partial data, and on revenue that ignores what each order cost you.

How it works

  1. Connect your store. Install PantoSource and sign in to your account.
  2. Connect your ad platforms. Sign in to each platform and approve access.
  3. Add your costs. Product cost, shipping, payment fees, and any custom fees.

You go live in 5 minutes, with no developer and no code.

Features

  • Fixed conversion data. Every conversion is captured server-side, even when the browser pixel is blocked, matched to its campaign, and counted once.
  • Enriched signals. Each conversion carries hashed customer details for better matching, valued at real profit (revenue minus product cost, shipping, payment fees, and any custom fees) or at revenue. You choose.
  • 8 ad platforms. Meta, Google, TikTok, Microsoft Advertising, Pinterest, Snapchat, X, and ChatGPT Ads.
  • AI chat through MCP. Ask Claude, ChatGPT, or any other AI chat what to fix, cut, and scale: campaign optimization, budget allocation, profit, POAS, conversions, customers, and creatives. It recommends, you decide. Builder plan and above.
  • Audience sync. Send custom audiences such as Top customers by profit to your ad platforms, exclude deep-discount buyers, and choose from many other ready-made audiences, each set up in a few clicks.
  • Profit and POAS reporting. See real profit and POAS (profit on ad spend) by campaign, channel, and store, after every cost.
  • Klaviyo. Send Klaviyo the checkouts and orders the browser misses, with added-to-cart and viewed-product events, and see flow and campaign results at profit.
  • Several stores, one account. Connect Shopify, WooCommerce, and Magento stores to one PantoSource account.

Who it is for

Ecommerce brands and agencies that want to fix their conversion data and make every ad decision on complete, enriched numbers, from what the ad platforms learn to where the next dollar goes.

Pricing

14-day free trial. Plans from $59 a month: Explore $59, Builder $169, and Team $279, with 20% off on yearly billing.

External services

This plugin connects to PantoSource, a service operated by Panto Martech LLC. A PantoSource account is required, and the plugin does not work without it.

When a shopper browses the store and places an order, the plugin sends store events to PantoSource: page URLs, product details, order values, and hashed customer details. It sends them only after the store owner has connected the plugin to a PantoSource account.

PantoSource uses this data to attribute orders to ads, send conversions and audiences to the ad platforms the store owner connects, and report results to the store owner. Those transfers to ad platforms, and to Klaviyo when connected, are made from PantoSource’s servers.

  • PantoSource Terms of Use
  • PantoSource Privacy Policy
  • PantoSource GDPR documentation
  • Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
  • Sub-processors

Privacy

PantoSource for WooCommerce sends store event data to the PantoSource platform, operated by Panto Martech LLC. This includes page URLs, product details, order values, and hashed customer details. The data is used to attribute orders to ads, send conversions and audiences to the ad platforms the store owner connects, and report results to the store owner. PantoSource does not sell personal data.

For full details, please review:

  • PantoSource Privacy Policy
  • PantoSource GDPR documentation
  • Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
  • Sub-processors
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins, then Add New, and search for “PantoSource”.
  2. Install and activate PantoSource for WooCommerce.
  3. Open the PantoSource settings and sign in to your PantoSource account, or start a 14-day free trial.
  4. In PantoSource, connect your ad platforms and add your product cost, shipping, payment fees, and any custom fees.
sections.faq:
Do I need a developer?

No. You connect your store, your ad platforms, and your costs in about 5 minutes, without code.

Which ad platforms does PantoSource work with?

Meta, Google, TikTok, Microsoft Advertising, Pinterest, Snapchat, X, and ChatGPT Ads.

Does it replace my ad pixels?

No. It works alongside them and sends each conversion from the server, so the conversions the pixel misses still reach your ad platforms. Each order is counted once.

Can I send revenue instead of profit?

Yes. You choose whether your ad platforms receive real profit or revenue as the conversion value.

How is profit worked out?

Profit is the order revenue minus the product cost, shipping, payment fees, and any custom fees you add in PantoSource.

Does it work with Klaviyo?

Yes. PantoSource sends Klaviyo the checkouts and orders the browser misses, adds profit values to profiles, and reports flow and campaign results at profit.

Which AI chats can I use?

Claude, ChatGPT, or any other AI chat that connects through the PantoSource MCP, on the Builder plan and above. Ask about campaigns, budgets, profit, POAS, conversions, or customers. The AI recommends, you decide.

How is customer data protected?

Customer details are hashed before they leave your store. PantoSource processes data on your behalf under a Data Processing Agreement and does not sell personal data.

Is there a free trial?

Yes. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial.
